title: Largest islands
prompt: Name the 10 largest islands in the world

source.name: Wikipedia: List of islands by area

answers.name: Greenland
aliases: Greenland of the Kingdom of Denmark

fact.text: The US secretly tried to build nuclear missile sites under its ice cap; Denmark only found out in 1997.
Its Fly River alone carries more water to the sea than all the rivers in Australia combined.
One of its caves is home to over three million bats, with guano piled more than 100 metres deep.
Its name may come from Marco Polo mixing it up with Mogadishu, in Somalia.
Its Mount Thor is said to have the greatest sheer vertical drop of any mountain on Earth.
It is home to Rafflesia arnoldii, the world's largest individual flower.
The 2011 earthquake shifted the island's northeast by as much as 5.3 metres.
It contains the world's largest island within an island within an island.
The name Britain may trace back to a Celtic word meaning "the painted ones" or "the tattooed folk".
More than fifty Norse artifacts, including pieces of chain mail, have been found at old Thule sites here.
